title: Freiburg demonstrators march with lanterns demanding climate action

tea.why: Protesters marched to demand stronger climate protection and climate justice during the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31).
tea.want: Industrialized nations must provide significantly more financial support to countries vulnerable to global warming impacts.
tea.changed: Nov 14, 2026: Hundreds of people marched through Freiburg with lanterns and string lights following speeches at Platz der Alten Synagoge.

summary: In Freiburg, hundreds of people participated in a lantern demonstration calling for stronger climate protection and climate justice, coinciding with the 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya. Organised by Fridays for Future, the action began with speeches and singing at Platz der Alten Synagoge before participants marched through the city centre. Demonstrators urged the German government and other industrialised countries to increase financial assistance for nations severely affected by climate change impacts. According to police estimates, around 300 individuals attended, whereas organisers reported approximately 1,000 participants.
demands: Greater climate protection and climate justice
Increased financial contributions from Germany and industrialised nations for climate adaptation in vulnerable countries
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: The police reported 300 participants, while organisers counted about 1,000 participants.

updates.text: Demonstrators gathered with lanterns, string lights, and music for a climate march in Freiburg.
